name: Golgfag Maneater
canonNotes: The most storied Ogre mercenary alive, leader of Golgfag's Maneaters, who once ate his human paymaster whole and left with the pay-chests.
Has won and lost more fortunes than can be counted; with enough loot and renown he may yet become a great Ogre ruler.
voiceNotes: Boastful storyteller and mercenary; everything is about pay, loot and a good tale.
Works for anyone who pays, but never forgets a bad deal.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
